definitions.explanation: A dictionary that provides English translations and explanations for Japanese words. The counterpart to an English-Japanese dictionary ({英和辞典|えいわじてん}).

examples.japanese: {和英辞典|わえいじてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I looked it up in a Japanese-English dictionary.

examples.japanese: {英作文|えいさくぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{和英辞典|わえいじてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}つ→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧。
examples.english: A Japanese-English dictionary is useful when writing English compositions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{和英辞典|わえいじてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{用例|ようれい}→用例：13578_yourei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧で、⟦{微妙|びみょう}→微妙：03589_bimyou⟧な⟦ニュアンス→ニュアンス：11138_nyuansu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: This Japanese-English dictionary is rich in usage examples and helps you understand subtle nuance differences.

notes:
Composed of {和|わ} (Japanese), {英|えい} (English), and ⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ (dictionary). The {和|わ} here is the same prefix seen in ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧ (Japanese food) and ⟦{和風|わふう}→和風：12034_wafuu⟧ (Japanese style). In the Japanese naming convention for bilingual dictionaries, the source language comes first: ⟦{和英|わえい}→和英：05253_waei⟧ means Japanese-to-English, while ⟦{英和|えいわ}→英和：04018_eiwa⟧ means English-to-Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和英辞典|わえいじてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to look up in a J-E dictionary
- {和英辞典|わえいじてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to check in a J-E dictionary
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{和英辞典|わえいじてん}: electronic J-E dictionary
- ⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧{和英辞典|わえいじてん}: online J-E dictionary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{英和辞典|えいわじてん}→英和辞典：23359_eiwajiten⟧: English-Japanese dictionary — the reverse direction, used when reading English
- ⟦{国語辞典|こくごじてん}→国語辞典：23277_kokugojiten⟧: Japanese-Japanese dictionary — a monolingual dictionary for native speakers
- ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧: dictionary — the general, everyday word for any dictionary
- ⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧: dictionary — more formal than ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧, often used in the titles of specific published dictionaries
